elements.text: It begins with ore and your first machines, then metallurgy and powering your base. Heat, the restructor and advanced materials come next, and with them the miner and the cryo chamber. Near the end come exotic matter on the magnet and, finally, the Dyson panel. Each step sets up the one after it.
Do not rush the top: the restructor and catalysts grow throughout the mod, while solar panels and storage scale your base along the way.
The magnet accelerator births exotic matter and star shards, which build the quantum capacitor, singularity core and stellar matrix — the apex materials.
The T10 solar panel is forged on the magnet from stellar matrices and a graviton coil — the mod’s largest generator. Array them in the Panel Combiner for a true Dyson swarm.
